title: Which tree runs?
summary: Mark MyFirstAuto as the main tree of its file.

say.never: `trees/my_first_auto.xml` now holds two trees: the auto, and `AimAndShoot`. When the robot runs this file, which one does it start? The one marked as the file's **main tree**. Only the auto should be: `AimAndShoot` runs because the auto uses it.
say.bit: A file can hold several trees. The robot runs the one marked **main**.

say.never: **Right-click** `MyFirstAuto` in the Trees list. A menu opens.

waitFor.hint: right-click MyFirstAuto in the Trees list.

say.never: Choose **Set as main tree of file**. A small **main** badge appears next to MyFirstAuto. (Another way: with the tree selected, tick **Main tree of its file** at the top of the Properties panel.)
say.bit: **Set as main tree of file**. Look for the **main** badge.

target.text: Set as main tree of file

waitFor.hint: choose Set as main tree of file.

say.never: Press **Save** (or **Ctrl+S**). The file now says which tree to run (`main_tree_to_execute` in the XML), so the robot runs your auto.
